Reviewed repository: AlexanderEastwood/riemann, commit b5bd5fa (2026-09-29).
RH, G2 and all original arithmetic continuation inputs remain open.
This is construction brainstorming, not proof or a numerical RH search.

Known obligations and controls:
- OPERATOR-BRIDGES groups distinct missing constructions: closed operator and
  evaluator control; complete structural transfer; de Branges extension and
  unshifted sign; arithmetic intersection construction and positivity transfer.
  These are separate gaps, not equivalent estimates.
- WEIL-FLOOR: the complete original signed Weil form on even source complement
  and odd sector must obey q_a[f]>=-C||f||² for one common cofinal C, with source
  transfer, all primes/powers, poles, archimedean, exterior and cross terms.
- NS47 restricts ordinary-L²-closable comparisons with bounded remainder.
  Merely renaming the signed comparison as curvature/Clifford positivity does
  not prove it; a proposed realization must respect the exact theorem's scope.
- NS94: reflection/inversion/count symmetry also holds for off-line controls.
- NS100/101: generic theta positivity and slice arguments do not supply the
  original full integrated sign. Match hypotheses of false analogues exactly.
- Fixed-window positivity or ground-transform proximity gives no cofinal RH
  estimate. No finite list of windows or locally fitted zeros is a bridge.
- The exact full NB residual gain and its complete tail are already available;
  the actual arithmetic lower bound remains open. Do not repackage that target.

Explicit toy constructions from this swarm (not newly proved RH mechanisms):
1. 4D exact symplectic prime block T*(R/log(p)Z) x R², lambda=tau dt+y dx,
   H=tau+xy. On H=1, the contact flow is (t+s,e^s x,e^-s y), with central
   primitive period log p. Graded horizontal-form supertrace and unstable
   covector half-density give the LOCAL orbit coefficient -log(p)p^(-m/2).
   For k transverse hyperbolic pairs with positive rates a_j and grading b,
   the coefficient is log(p)(-1)^(k+b)p^(-m sum(a_j)/2). Match requires
   sum(a_j)=1 and k+b odd. This finite algebra does not establish a global
   flat trace, spectral realization, gamma/pole completion or positivity.
   Composite labels 4 and 6 satisfy the same local geometry but add wrong
   primitive support/weights. A connected gluing may create unwanted cycles.
2. E_p=C*/p^Z is a complex elliptic curve; E_p x E_q has four real dimensions.
   z->p^k z becomes the identity on E_p. The map [n]:z->z^n has degree n²
   and is not a substitute. A naive simultaneous flow for p=2,q=3 has no
   common positive period. Return labels before quotient/groupoid data are
   extra structure. Ordinary divisor classes can also erase arithmetic;
   adelic metrics/intersections need exact normalization and transfer.
3. The real 4D two-prime oscillator H=log(2)N_2+log(3)N_3 has partition
   [(1-2^-s)(1-3^-s)]^-1 for Re s>0. Infinitely many prime modes give the
   Euler product only in Re s>1. Its self-adjoint energies are log integers,
   not zeta zeros. Required completion/continuation/spectral transfer is absent.
   Suzuki's existing canonical-system program uses
   Theta_a(z)=xi(1/2-a-iz)/xi(1/2+a-iz). Analytic contractivity for all a>0
   would exclude uncancelled denominator zeros in Im z>0; this is a known
   RH-strength bridge, not a construction supplied here. An independent
   passive Euler port fails: for z=iy,y>1/2+a, its factor
   (1-p^[-(1/2+a+y)])/(1-p^[-(1/2-a+y)]) is >1.
   A coupled construction including gamma and poles remains a separate task.

Useful output: a precisely defined modification with an independent first
construction test, all missing companions and a complete conditional edge.
